description: Rename-aware path-keyed baseline relabel INVARIANCE (task #64). The scm-facts emitter has already relabeled the frozen merge-base face: a moved residue file's OLD path key (under a residue code, e.g. cloud/cloud-observability/.../src/lib.rs) was relabeled to its NEW path key (observability/core/aggregate/src/lib.rs) because the move was pure (NEW occurrence-set subset of OLD). The firewall is pure DATA-over-DATA — it never sees content, paths, or git, so this fixture uses an OPAQUE residue code/keys (stem-free by design, mirroring the firewall's content-blindness). It differences the candidate (NEW path) against the relabeled-frozen (NEW path): tolerated, zero regressions, zero growth => GREEN. This is the move-3 unblock: a strangler move of an already-accepted residue file is no longer read as NEW debt. The relabel DECISION itself is pinned in the emitter's relabel_green_pure_move_relabels_old_to_new unit test; this fixture pins that the firewall is INVARIANT under an already-relabeled frozen face.
